arguments.sql:
SELECT
    ym.Date,
    c.Currency,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_rows,
    COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS matched_rows,
    COUNT(ym.Consumption) AS recorded_values,
    SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(ym.Consumption) IN ('integer', 'real') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric_values
FROM yearmonth AS ym
LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date IN ('201304', '201305', '201306')
GROUP BY ym.Date, c.Currency
ORDER BY ym.Date, c.Currency

arguments.sql:
WITH quarterly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        c.Currency,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS quarter_total
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date IN ('201304', '201305', '201306')
      AND c.Currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Currency
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN quarter_total END), 2) AS eur_avg_quarterly_consumption,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN quarter_total END), 2) AS czk_avg_quarterly_consumption
FROM quarterly_consumption
LIMIT 1
